MR BHAVIK R SAMANI(8339) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR UTKARSH SHARMA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE A.Y. KOGJE  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SAMIR J. DAVE  Date : 09/10/2024  ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE A.Y. KOGJE)
1.

This application is filed for restoring the acquittal appeal preferred by the victim-applicant, which came to be dismissed for want of prosecution by an order dated 28.08.2023, whereby on account of non-removal of office objections on or before 11.09.2023, the matter stood dismissed for non-prosecution.

This Court in a separate order passed today in application for condoning delay has condoned the delay for preferring restoration application against the aforesaid dismissal for want of Radhaben W/O Arvindbhai Dhirabhai ... vs State Of Gujarat on 9 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129833165/
1 prosecution.
2.

sentences.text: Considering the same reason assigned in the application for condoning of delay, the Court deems it fit that a valuable right of the applicant needs to be addressed NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20171/2024 ORDER DATED: 09/10/2024 undefined particularly when the offences of nature as under section 376(2)(N), 452, 323 and 506(2) of IPC and when the applicant herself is an illiterate tribal woman.
3. In view of the above, the application is allowed.
The appeal is ordered to be restored and be listed for admission.

(A.Y. KOGJE, J) (SAMIR J. DAVE,J) MEHUL B. TUVAR Radhaben W/O Arvindbhai Dhirabhai ... vs State Of Gujarat on 9 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/129833165/
